page_title: CEL 0-2 ESP | Celta Vigo v Espanyol 12/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Mateo Busquets has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

90+3' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat. The ball goes out of play. Celta Vigo are awarded a corner kick.
90+2' Celta Vigo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. It will be a corner kick for Celta Vigo.
90+2' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball is out of play. Celta Vigo will have a chance to score from a corner.
90+1' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
90+1' Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick. The corner kick from Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
90+1' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Corner kick. Celta Vigo will have an opportunity.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
89' Pere Milla (Espanyol) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
86' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

86' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) goes on a mazy run and ends with a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender makes a decent block. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Celta Vigo.

85' CHANCE! Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) picks up a perfect pass inside the box, makes himself some space for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
83' Manolo Gonzalez decides to make a substitution. Roberto Fernandez Jaen will be replaced by Fernando Calero (Espanyol).
83' Walid Cheddira (Espanyol) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Javi Puado.

82' OFF THE CROSSBAR! Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
81' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
78' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
77' The referee gives a yellow card to Javi Puado (Espanyol) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
75' Substitution. Pere Milla (Espanyol) has come on for Exposito.
74' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) takes the corner kick, but Joan Garcia reads it well and stops the effort.
74' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Celta Vigo will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
71' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
71' Claudio Giraldez has decided to substitute Sergio Carreira and he is replaced by Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo).
70' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
69' The corner from Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) is hurriedly cleared.
69' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Celta Vigo comes to nothing. Celta Vigo have a corner.

69' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he unleashed a powerful shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the bottom left corner, but Joan Garcia made a crucial save! The linesman points to the corner flag, Celta Vigo are going to take it.
68' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
65' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jailson (Celta Vigo) was quite harsh and Mateo Busquets didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
64' Antoniu Roca comes off the pitch to be replaced by Jofre (Espanyol).
63' 0 - 2 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 0:2.
62' The substitution is prepared. Jailson (Celta Vigo) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Javier Rodriguez.
62' None of the Celta Vigo players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.

62' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Celta Vigo win a corner.
62' Here is a change. Iago Aspas is going off and Claudio Giraldez gives the last tactical orders to Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo).
59' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
56' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) takes the corner but it's cleared.

55' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the roof of the net. Joan Garcia is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
54' Exposito (Espanyol) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
54' Exposito (Espanyol) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert. Espanyol force their opponents to concede a corner.
53' Alex Kral (Espanyol) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
52' Espanyol are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The ball is out of play. Espanyol will have a throw-in.
49' Exposito (Espanyol) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

49' Antoniu Roca (Espanyol) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Espanyol will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
48' Espanyol seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

47' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom right corner. Joan Garcia has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) comes off for Ilaix Moriba.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Manolo Gonzalez gives a chance to Alex Kral and Pol Lozano (Espanyol) is off.
46' Mateo Busquets blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
45+3' Celta Vigo are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
45+1' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) attempted to curl the ball over the defensive wall from the free kick, but with no success.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
44' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) has tested the patience of referee Mateo Busquets and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

43' Celta Vigo slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.

39' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Joan Garcia pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going into the bottom right corner.
36' Espanyol seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

33' Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
32' Exposito (Espanyol) will take a corner kick.

32' Exposito (Espanyol) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the roof of the net, but Vicente Guaita is alert and denies him with a nice save. Espanyol will take a corner kick.

32' Espanyol are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
28' 0 - 1 Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and fires into the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
28' Exposito (Espanyol) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
26' Mateo Busquets blows his whistle. Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) commits a foul after dangerous play.

24' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Espanyol are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
22' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
21' The corner is swung in but Celta Vigo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
21' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
20' Celta Vigo show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
19' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
15' Claudio Giraldez is forced to make a change. Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Carlos Dominguez.

15' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom right corner. Joan Garcia is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
13' Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
12' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
11' Wonderful movement by Espanyol. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
9' The resulting set piece from Espanyol is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
9' Exposito (Espanyol) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Espanyol earn a corner.
6' Celta Vigo keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball.
4' Espanyol are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
2' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Espanyol will have a goal kick.
